correctionsToUserNotes: SEEK is not entirely training-free: train a three-hidden-layer RSN MLP on 100 GPT-4-labelled objects with frozen pretrained embeddings.
Scene Difference uses OFA Image Captioning interface per section II-B despite abstract VQA phrasing.
Scene Difference threshold anomaly detection is discussed; no calibrated universal threshold, accuracy or AUROC is reported.
numericalProtocolDecisions: SEEK table I separates fixed and movable objects, all methods have Si=1 under target existence and unlimited simulation time.
SEEK table II measures fit to GPT-4 labels for 40 held-out objects; not real-world probability calibration.
SEEK hardware SPL=0.93 is one shown run, not a multi-run mean.
Scene Difference SD<0.2 and SD≈0.14 follow author text for figures 6–8, preserving precision.
Scene Difference weighting experiment draws 10 questions from 67 into 10000 sets; no curve values fabricated.
